Where Shopify Ends and Development Begins

We build them with Liquid, the Shopify APIs and custom apps, so the store keeps working through platform updates instead of breaking on the next theme release.

Ten Apps Is Usually Nine Too Many

Each installed app injects its own scripts and styles. The cumulative effect on load time is often larger than any single app owner would admit.

We audit the stack, measure what each app actually costs you, and build the few features you genuinely need directly into the theme.

Talk to Us

Customise Without Breaking Upgrades

Editing theme files directly is how stores end up unable to take an update. Done that way, every improvement becomes a merge conflict.

We structure customisations so platform and theme updates remain routine, and document what was changed and why.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do we need Shopify Plus?

Only if you need checkout customisation, scripts, multiple storefronts or the higher API limits. Below that, standard Shopify is usually sufficient.

Can you build a custom app for us?

Yes. Private apps are the right answer when a workflow is specific to your business and no public app fits it well.

Will customisations survive Shopify updates?

Yes, if they are built the supported way. We avoid the shortcuts that make future updates painful.

Can you take over an existing Shopify store?

Yes. We audit the theme and app stack first so you know what state it is in before we change anything.

Hit the Limits of What Shopify Does by Default?

Tell us what you need it to do and we will tell you how it is built.
